requirements.text: Streamline appointment booking, cancellation, and rescheduling to alleviate the burden on reception staff during peak hours.
Facilitate easy and convenient repeat prescription requests for patients without the need for phone calls.
Provide secure online access to test results for patients after clinician review, enhancing transparency and patient engagement.
Ensure high standards of data security and compliance with GDPR.
Create a user-friendly system that is accessible for all patients, including the elderly and those with low digital literacy.
Patients should be able to see real-time availability for appointments.
It should be easy for patients to cancel or reschedule their appointments online.
A feature that allows patients with urgent symptoms to flag their needs for same-day or emergency appointments.
Patients should receive a confirmation email or message after booking an appointment.
Automated reminders should be sent out before the appointment via patients' preferred method of communication.
The booking process needs to seamlessly integrate with current practice management software.
Patients should have a clear and simple way to navigate to the repeat prescription request section on the portal.
Patients should be able to see their previous prescriptions, including what medications they’ve been prescribed and when they were last filled.
An easy-to-fill-out form for patients to submit their repeat prescription requests.
The request should be securely submitted for clinician review.
Patients should be able to track the status of their prescription requests.
Integration with local pharmacies so that once a prescription is approved, it can be sent directly to the patient’s preferred pharmacy.
Patients should receive notifications when their prescription request is received and when it’s ready for pickup.
Patients should be able to securely access test results through the portal after clinician review.
Test results should be presented in a clear and easily understandable format, including explanations or reference ranges for lab values.
There should be a protocol for clinicians to communicate critical results directly to patients.
Include contextual information or educational resources related to the test results.
Patients should have a feature that allows them to send questions or comments about their results directly to their clinician.
Patients should receive notifications when new test results are available.
Patients should have access to their past test results for reference.
We have a limited budget for this project, necessitating a cost-effective solution.
The portal must comply with GDPR and applicable Irish data protection laws.
The portal needs to integrate smoothly with current practice management software without requiring full data migration.
We must assess the existing infrastructure for compatibility with new technologies.
The portal must ensure usability for patients with low digital literacy and minimal training for the reception team.
We need a strategy to encourage patient adoption of the portal.
The portal should adhere to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Implement a feature for patients to provide feedback about their experience with the portal.
Include support resources within the portal, such as FAQs and video tutorials.
Provide clear pathways for patients to reach out for urgent issues.
Implement analytics capabilities to monitor usage patterns and trends.
